readerCopy.body: A current decision may show you exactly how much an old identity still has a vote. When the Sun opposes the South Node, the person you are trying to be can come face to face with a role, expectation, or source of recognition that has shaped you for a long time. You may feel pulled between keeping a familiar place and making room for something less established. The past does not have to be rejected to stop running the decision. Carry forward the part that still works and leave the rest where it belongs.
